overview: The MPS High School Building Committee reviewed educational program updates and 29 conceptual design alternatives for the high school project, ranging from code upgrades to new construction. The committee voted to advance all presented models for initial cost estimation to support the upcoming Preliminary Design Program submission.

items.title: Meeting Introduction and Translation Services
items.summary: The chair introduced interpreters for Portuguese, Haitian Creole, and Spanish to assist residents during the meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from November 24 and December 22, 2025, with a date correction on the latter.

items.title: Approval of Invoices
items.summary: Approved invoices totaling $160,000 for project management and architectural services provided by Left Field and SMMA.

items.title: Contract Amendment for Geo-Environmental Work
items.summary: Approved a contract amendment for phase two geo-environmental site testing, reallocating existing contingency funds within the feasibility budget.

items.title: Educational Program and Square Footage Update
items.summary: Matt Rice detailed proposed increases to the building's net square footage driven by expanded vocational programs, special education requirements, and consolidated preschool classrooms.

items.title: Presentation of High-Level Cost Alternatives
items.summary: The project team presented 29 conceptual models categorized into code upgrades, additions/renovations, and new construction to establish baseline cost models and evaluate site placement options.

items.title: Public Comment and Committee Discussion
items.summary: Residents and committee members discussed the potential disruption of athletic fields during construction, parking garage feasibility, and the impact of local zoning changes on future enrollment.

items.title: Authorization of Cost Estimation
items.summary: Approved a motion to move all 29 presented design alternatives forward for initial cost estimation by the project's estimators.

subject: High School Educational Program and Design Alternatives
